scenes.title_cn: 方法：问自己十遍为什么
scenes.title_en: The Method: Ask Yourself 'Why' Ten Times
scenes.context: 全世界所有的产品我都能卖。来看一块香牌，首先我不认识它，不知道它是什么料子、什么雕刻。我根本不懂。那我们尝试一下我是怎么讲它的：首先我拿着它，会问自己十遍为什么——我喜欢它。语域：直播教学，方法演示。
sentences: 全世界所有的产品，我都能卖。
I can sell any product in the world.
sell any product（卖所有产品）
首先我不认识它，不懂它是什么料子、什么雕刻。
I don't recognize it — I don't know its material or its carving.
its material or carving（料子和雕刻）
我拿着它，会问自己十遍为什么。
I hold it and ask myself 'why' ten times.
ask myself why（问自己为什么）
paraphrase: 料子 → material / the raw stuff
问十遍为什么 → ask why ten times / dig for the reasons
scenes.speak: I can sell any product in the world. I don't recognize it — I don't know its material or its carving. I hold it and ask myself 'why' ten times.

scenes.context: 第一个为什么：我喜欢它，因为它好看。普通的衣服搭上香牌，就变得很有调性。好看是第一卖点。语域：直播教学，卖点拆解。
sentences: 为什么喜欢它？因为它好看。
Why do I like it? Because it looks great.
it looks great（好看）
普通的衣服，搭上香牌就很有调性。
A plain outfit gains character once paired with the plaque.
gains character（有调性）
好看，是第一卖点。
Good looks are the first selling point.
the first selling point（第一卖点）
paraphrase: 调性 → character / a distinctive vibe
卖点 → selling point / the hook
scenes.speak: Why do I like it? Because it looks great. A plain outfit gains character once paired with the plaque. Good looks are the first selling point.

scenes.title_cn: 卖点2-3：真有香味 + 三种香
scenes.title_en: Points 2–3: Real Fragrance and Three Aromas
scenes.context: 第二个为什么：它真有香味，紧张、卡壳、无聊时闻一闻。第三个为什么：沉香等三种香汇成，雕刻漂亮。语域：直播教学，卖点拆解。
sentences: 它真有香味，紧张卡壳时闻一闻。
It has real fragrance — take a sniff when you're nervous or blanking.
blanking（卡壳）
沉香等三种香，汇成一块。
Three aromas including agarwood blend into one plaque.
agarwood（沉香）
雕刻漂亮，喜欢打个1。
The carving is beautiful — like it, drop a '1'.
drop a 1（打个1）
paraphrase: 三种香 → three aromas / a blend of three
scenes.speak: It has real fragrance — take a sniff when you're nervous or blanking. Three aromas including agarwood blend into one plaque. The carving is beautiful — like it, drop a '1'.

scenes.title_en: The Short Script and the Takeaway
scenes.context: 短版话术：这条漂亮吧？香料香牌不卖，当地给，要的打1。基本功扎实，任何产品都能张口就来。语域：直播教学，收尾。
sentences: 短版话术：这条漂亮吧？
Short script: this one's pretty, right?
short script（短版话术）
香料香牌，要的打1。
Spice plaque — want one? Drop a '1'.
want one（要的）
基本功扎实，任何产品都张口就来。
With solid basics, scripts come to you on demand for any product.
on demand（张口就来）
paraphrase: 短版话术 → short script / the one-liner
张口就来 → on demand / off the top of the head
scenes.speak: Short script: this one's pretty, right? Spice plaque — want one? Drop a '1'. With solid basics, scripts come to you on demand for any product.

practice: I hold it and ask myself 'why' ten times.
A plain outfit gains character once paired with the plaque.
It has real fragrance — take a sniff when you're blanking.
With solid basics, scripts come to you on demand for any product.
pitfalls: I can sell any product in the world.
「所有产品」用 any product in the world。
I ask myself why for ten times.
「问十遍」用 ask myself why ten times。
A plain outfit gains character once paired with the plaque.
shifts: 用 ask myself why（问为什么）、selling point（卖点）、the hook（钩子）
用 short script（短版话术）、on demand（张口就来）、drop a '1'（打个1）
